system.description:
Adds +2 DCV per level when using a specific fighting technique.
Level 1: Defence Combat Value increases by 2 when using a specific technique
Level 2: Defence Combat Value increases by 4 when using a specific technique
Level 3: Defence Combat Value increases by 6 when using a specific technique
Level 4: Defence Combat Value increases by 8 when using a specific technique
Level 5: Defence Combat Value increases by 10 when using a specific technique
Level 6: Defence Combat Value increases by 12 when using a specific technique
